# GBIF data user agreement and citation guidelines

Third-party documents, vendored as a record of the terms BirdView complies with.
**Not covered by BirdView's Apache 2.0 license, and not openly licensed.** The
documents are GBIF Secretariat's; BirdView claims no rights in them and grants none.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Files** | `data-user.html`, `citation-guidelines.html` |
| **Origin** | <https://www.gbif.org/terms/data-user> and <https://www.gbif.org/citation-guidelines> |
| **Version** | Retrieved 2026-11-03; the data user agreement reads "last updated: 15 September 2026" |
| **Owner** | GBIF Secretariat |
| **License** | None stated on either page. |
| **Modifications** | `<script>`, `<style>` and `<link>` elements removed, so the copies are inert, and the signed-in account name in the site header replaced with `[signed-in user]`. Nothing else is changed: the text is never reformatted, reworded or partially quoted. |
| **Used for** | Nothing at runtime. BirdView's requirements quote these documents, and the copies let a reader check every quotation against the exact text it came from. |

Retrieval details and the SHA-256 each file is checked against are recorded once, in
[river/requirements/imported/gbif.org/gbifterms/PROVENANCE.md](../../river/requirements/imported/gbif.org/gbifterms/PROVENANCE.md),
and verified by `river/check/pins_test.go`.
